Large fire pit with seating

Between the covered terrace and the children's playground is a large fire pit with seating for the whole group. Firewood is free for staying guests.

By the fire pit you'll find sausage sticks, and above the fire hangs a stainless-steel grill grate. Raise or lower it to control how fast your meat or vegetables cook.

  • Free firewood for guests
  • Sausage roasting sticks
  • Height-adjustable stainless-steel grate
  • Seating around the fire
